title.narrative: Mali Electricity System Reinforcement and Access Expansion Project (YELEN SIRA)

description.narrative: The Project Development Objectives (PDO) are to (i) improve power system reliability and efficiency, (ii) increase access to electricity in selected areas, and (iii) facilitate the integration of renewable energy.

The objectives of the Electricity System Reinforcement and Access Expansion Project for Mali are to (i) improve power system reliability and efficiency, (ii) increase access to electricity in selected areas, and (iii) facilitate the integration of renewable energy. The project has four components. (1) Reinforcement of grid infrastructure and access expansion (US$284 million equivalent component will finance critical grid infrastructure and new connections. (2) Green mini-grid and off-grid electrification of selected localities in rural areas component will contribute to reducing disparity of access to electricity services between urban and rural areas and providing cleaner and more affordable electricity for socioeconomic development in rural areas. The proposed component aims to deploy technologies61 and new business models that would reduce fossil fuel use, save costs, tap into local renewable energy resources, and ensure more reliable service provision. (3) The Institutional Capacity Building and Implementation support component will finance activities to create a robust institutional arrangement to implement the proposed project and to support the energy sector's overall development. (4) Contingent Emergency Response Component (CERC) component will contribute to an emergency response through the timely implementation of activities in response to an eligible national emergency.

condition.narrative: ESCP, ESS 1.2: MMEE, in coordination with the PIUs, shall prepare, approve and adopt the SEA/SH Action Plan no later than three (3)months after the effective date and implemented throughout the implementation of the Project.
ESCP, ESS 10.3: The project GRM must be operational by no later than three (3) months after the Effective Date and thereaftermaintained operational for the life of the Project.

Schedule 2, Section I.A.2 (IDA FA; GCF FA; ESMAP GA): The Recipient shall establish not later than three (3) months after theEffective Date or any later date as agreed by the Association, the Project Steering Committee and thereafter shall maintain itsparticipation and shall cause the Project Implementing Entities and the Partner Entities to maintain their participation,throughout the Project implementation period, in said Project Steering Committee with composition, mandate and resourcessatisfactory to the Association, to be chaired by MMEE, and to be comprised of, inter alia, representatives of the Recipient'sministries responsible for finance and local government, Project Implementing Entities and the Partner Entities. To this end, theRecipient shall ensure that the Project Steering Committee is responsible for endorsing the Annual Work Plans and Budgets for theProject, strategic guidance and overall oversight of the Project.

Schedule 2, Section I.B.1(b) (IDA FA & GCF FA); Schedule Section I1(b) (IDA PA EDM & GCF PA EDM): the obligation of the EDM tomaintain, throughout Project implementation adequate staffing, personnel and procedures for the implementation of the Project, asfurther detailed in the Project Implementation Manual, including, inter alia: (i) the recruitment of a financial managementspecialist not later than three (3) months after the Effective Date;

Schedule 2, Section I.B.1(b) (IDA FA & GCF FA); Schedule Section I1(b) (IDA PA EDM & GCF PA EDM): the obligation of the EDM tomaintain, throughout Project implementation adequate staffing, personnel and procedures for the implementation of the Project, asfurther detailed in the Project Implementation Manual, including, inter alia: (ii) the updating of the accounting software notlater than three (3) months after the Effective Date;

Schedule 2, Section I.B.1(b) (IDA FA & GCF FA); Schedule Section I1(b) (IDA PA EDM & GCF PA EDM): the obligation of the EDM tomaintain, throughout Project implementation adequate staffing, personnel and procedures for the implementation of the Project, asfurther detailed in the Project Implementation Manual, including, inter alia: (iii) the recruitment of an external auditor incharge of the external audit of both Project Implementing Entities not later than six (6) months after the Effective Date; or suchlater date as agreed by the Association.

Schedule 2, Section I.C.1(b) (IDA FA & GCF FA); Schedule 2, Section I.B.1(b) (ESMAP GA); Schedule Section IB1(b) (IDA PA AMADER,GCF PA AMADER & ESMAP PA AMADER): the obligation of the AMADER to maintain, throughout Project implementation adequate staffing,personnel and procedures for the implementation of the Project, as further detailed in the Project Implementation Manual,including, inter alia: (i) the recruitment of an internal auditor in charge of the internal audit of both Project ImplementingEntities, one senior accountant and two assistant accountants not later than three (3) months after the Effective Date; and (ii)the updating of the accounting software not later than three (3) months after the Effective Date; or such later date as agreed bythe Association.

Schedule 2, Section I.E.1 (IDA FA & GCF FA); Section I.D.1 (ESMAP GA); Schedule C1 (ID PA EDM & GCF PA EDM): To facilitate thecarrying out of Parts 1.2 and 3.1 of the Project, the Recipient shall no later than 3 months after the Effective Date or any laterdate as agreed by the Association] cause EDM to enter into memoranda of cooperation with the Partner Entities (the “Memoranda ofCooperation”), under terms and conditions approved by the Association and in accordance with the Project Implementation Manual.

Schedule 2, Section IV (IDA FA & GCF FA); Schedule Section III.1 (IDA PA EDM) and Section III.2 (GCF PA EDM): For theimplementation of Part 1.2.2 of the Project, the Recipient shall cause EDM to submit to the Association / Bank, no later than six(6) months after the Effective Date, a report with updated information concerning (i) the power plant projects which will beconnected to the interconnected network of EDM, and (ii) the progress of network reinforcement work on the EDM interconnectednetwork, in form and substance satisfactory to the Association.
